reviews.text: Rachel at Salon BeYoutiful did such a great job on my hair! She gave me a beautiful honey balayage, and a haircut to match my vision. I also have allergies to some cosmetic products and she was so careful to check every product she used on me. Would recommend her for all your haircare needs.
I've seen Hannah for facials for a few months now and she is wonderful!! Very receptive and curates each appointment to what I'm needing and how I'm feeling. Highly recommend 😊

I got a brow lamination and tint and lash lift and tint from Hannah, and it was amazing! She talked me through each step of the process, made sure I was comfortable throughout, and did an amazing job🩷 highly recommend
